manual_annotation_disclosure.form: single-pass reasoning over printed samples during the authoring conversation, not persisted as a structured per-item label file
manual_annotation_disclosure.not_auditable: the 36%/32%/32% (lexical) and 70%/28%/2% (BGE) percentages quoted in the sanitized summary doc came from one annotator's (this session's) single read of 50 sampled states each; no independent second rater, no saved per-item label table, no adjudication. This is exactly the gap the user identified and the reason these numbers must be labeled diagnostic/unaudited, not confirmed results.
